title: Spousal
summary: SPOUSAL, adjective [from spouse.] Pertaining to marriage; nuptial; matrimonial; conjugal; connubial; bridal; as spousal rites; spousal ornaments. SPOUSAL, noun [Latin See Spouse.] Marriage; nuptials.

inlines.v: SPOUSAL, adjective [from spouse.] Pertaining to marriage; nuptial; matrimonial; conjugal; connubial; bridal; as spousal rites; spousal ornaments. SPOUSAL, noun [Latin See Spouse.] Marriage; nuptials. It is now generally used in the plural; as the spousals of Hippolita.
